title: Luxuriously Smoked Kenyan Potato Kebabs
description: Indulge in the rich flavors of Kenya with these smoky potato kebabs, featuring a bitter cheese pull and a hint of tandoor spice, all while being FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the diced potatoes with tandoor spice, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Thread the spiced potatoes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the potatoes with vegetable oil and place the skewers on the preheated grill.
Close the grill lid and smoke the potatoes for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly charred.
While the potatoes are cooking, melt the bitter cheese in a saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly.
Once the potatoes are done, remove them from the grill and brush them with the melted cheese.
Garnish the kebabs with chopped fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the cheese to set.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
